This Privacy Policy explains how NATUTECH S.L. (hereinafter, “Cuentia”, “we”, or “our”) collects, uses and protects the personal data of users who access the website https://cuentia.net (hereinafter, the “Website”). By using Cuentia, you accept this Privacy Policy.

Contact email: cuentia@cuentia.net.
Trade name used: Cuentia.

2. Data We Collect
Cuentia collects only the data necessary to provide its service:
• Registration data: email and password (encrypted).
• Data provided by the user: story title, descriptions, text, character names and any written information used to create the story.
• Photos uploaded by the user to generate characters using AI.
• Technical data: IP address, device, session identifiers and basic usage necessary for platform functionality.
• Payment data processed by Stripe (we do not store card information).

3. Purpose of Processing
Data is used exclusively to:
• Create and manage the user account.
• Generate personalized AI characters.
• Create digital stories in PDF format.
• Send notifications related to the story or the account (e.g., “your story is ready”).
• Permanently store PDFs and generated images so the user can access them at any time.
• Manage payments, billing and subscriptions.
• Ensure the security and correct functioning of the Website.
Cuentia does not sell, rent or transfer user data to third parties.

4. Processing of Photos and Uploaded Content
Photos uploaded to generate characters are processed as follows:
• Stored for a maximum of 24 hours in a temporary space.
• After generating character images, the original photos are automatically deleted.
• Photos are used exclusively to create AI illustrations.
• The generated character images (not the original photos) are stored permanently for future use.
The user guarantees they have the rights and permissions to upload such photos, including parental/guardian consent for minors.

5. Legal Basis for Processing
We process personal data based on:
• Contract performance: creation of the account, story generation and PDF delivery.
• Consent: use of photos to generate AI characters.
• Legitimate interest: improving and securing the Website’s technical operation.
• Legal obligation: billing and tax compliance.

6. Data Retention
• Uploaded photos: up to 24 hours, then deleted.
• AI-generated character images: stored permanently until deleted by the user.
• Generated PDFs: stored permanently until deleted.
• Account data: stored while the account remains active.
If the user deletes their account, data will be irreversibly deleted except data required by law.

7. Data Processors and Transfers
Service providers used:
• AWS S3: storage of PDFs and images.
• Firebase / Firestore: account and database management.
• Stripe: payment processing.
• AI systems (OpenAI or others): text and image generation.

Some providers are outside the EU. Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) apply.

• Access their data.
• Rectify inaccurate data.
• Request deletion of data.
• Object to processing.
• Restrict processing.
• Request portability.
• Withdraw consent.
To exercise rights: cuentia@cuentia.net.
They may also contact the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD).

9. Data Security
Measures applied:
• HTTPS encryption.
• Encrypted passwords.
• Secure servers.
• Restricted access.
No system is 100% infallible, but we apply strict measures.

10. Account and Data Deletion
When deleting the account:
• PDFs are erased.
• Generated images are erased.
• Registration data is deleted.
• Temporary photos are deleted.
Data required by law is kept as permitted.

CookiePolicyPage.title: Cookie Policy
CookiePolicyPage.content:
Last updated: [November 30, 2025]

1. What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored in the user’s browser when visiting a website. They allow the site to remember information about the visit (such as chosen language or session status), and in some cases help ensure transaction security.

This Policy also includes similar storage technologies, such as browser storage (Local Storage, Session Storage, IndexedDB), used for similar purposes.

⸻

2. Who is responsible for processing?

The data controller for personal data associated with cookie use on this website is:

Company: NATUTECH, S.L.
CIF: B24793663
Address: CALLE MONESTIR DE POBLET, NUM 46, PUERTA 2, 46015, VALÈNCIA (Valencia), Spain
Contact email: cuentia@cuentia.net

⸻

3. Types of cookies

Cookies may be classified as follows:

a) According to who manages them:
• First-party cookies: sent to the user's device from a domain managed by the website owner.
• Third-party cookies: sent to the user's device from a domain managed by an external entity.

b) According to their purpose:
• Technical/necessary cookies: enable browsing and use of website services (session management, security, payments).
• Preference/customization cookies: remember user settings such as language.
• Analytics cookies: track and analyze user behavior.
• Behavioral advertising cookies: store behavioral data to display personalized ads.

This website only uses technical/necessary and preference cookies, essential for proper functioning and payment processing. No analytics or advertising cookies are used.

c) According to duration:
• Session cookies: deleted when the browser closes.
• Persistent cookies: stored for a defined period.

⸻

4. Cookies used on this website

We only use cookies and storage mechanisms required to provide the service:

4.1. First-party cookies
Language cookie (Next-Intl)
• Name: NEXT_LOCALE
• Provider: First-party (Cuentia / NATUTECH, S.L.)
• Purpose: Remember the user’s selected language.
• Type: Preference (functional) cookie.
• Duration: According to your app configuration.

4.2. Third-party cookies
Stripe cookies (payment platform)
Used when interacting with the payment system.
• Provider: Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd.
• Domain: checkout.stripe.com and others.
• Purpose:
• Verify user and device identity.
• Prevent fraud.
• Ensure secure payment processing.
• Type: Technical/necessary.
• Examples:
• __stripe_mid (persistent)
• __stripe_sid (session)

4.3. Similar technologies: Firebase local storage
• Technology: IndexedDB / Local Storage (Firebase Authentication).
• Purpose: Maintain login status and secure access.
• Type: Technical/necessary.
• Duration: Persistent unless session is closed or browser data is cleared.

⸻

5. Is consent required?

No. These cookies are necessary to:
• Remember language
• Maintain authentication
• Process payments securely

Under GDPR and LSSI, these cookies do not require prior consent.

If non-essential cookies are added, a consent banner will be implemented.

⸻

6. How to manage or delete cookies

Users may:
• Configure their browser to block/delete cookies.
• Clear browsing data.

Deleting necessary cookies may cause some site features not to function properly.

Useful links:
• Google Chrome
• Mozilla Firefox
• Safari
• Edge
• Opera

⸻

7. International data transfers

Stripe and Firebase may transfer data outside the EEA (e.g., USA).
Such transfers use legal safeguards (Standard Contractual Clauses).
